messages:
Maya R.: (2201234567) Quick heads-up — canary perf run 03:14 UTC shows p95 jump on route `/v1/chat` at ~60% util. p95 went 120ms -> 380ms. :grimacing:
Sam K.: Same, noticed spikes correlate with kernel switchover logs + increased KV cache misses. stack traces show microbatching waiting longer.
Raj P.: digging... profiler shows `batch_former` held requests 14-18ms longer during switchover. KV eviction rate spiked ~3x.
Lena T.: Important: We rolled kernel selector change last night (heuristic: prefer int8 kernels for tiled-attn). Could be triggering more frequent kernel migrations for long sequences.
Maya R.: Right. Hypothesis: kernel routing + aggressive batch token cap increases queueing for some route tiers. We need dynamic token budgets by route/tier tied to p95 SLO.
Sam K.: Agreed. Proposed quick experiment: per-route token_budget target = min( max_tokens, tier_budget * (1 + slope*(latency_ratio - 1)) ). Start with tier_budget=1024 for standard, slope=0.5.
Raj P.: I can implement a canary that observes realtime p95 and adjusts token_budget every 30s. Also add hysteresis to avoid thrash.
PerfBot: alert: canary-run-220123 - p95 exceeded threshold on /v1/chat at 03:14 UTC. KV miss-rate=0.72, kernel_switches=12/min.
Lena T.: Also add prefetch KV heuristic: when kernel_selector signals upcoming kernel (fp16->int8), pre-warm KV entries for recent prefixes to cut misses.
Maya R.: Good call. Let's try: 1) dynamic token budget by route/tier tied to p95 2) KV prefetch on kernel hint 3) conservative kernel fallback window (2s) to reduce switchover freq.
Sam K.: Experiment plan: rollout to canary group 10% of traffic for 4h, collect p50/p95/p99, kernel_switch rate, kv_miss_rate. If p95 drop >10ms and kv_miss_rate decreases -> promote.
Raj P.: quick config (will push to test):
```
route_tiers:
  standard: { tier_budget: 1024, slope: 0.5, min_budget: 512, max_budget: 2048 }
  premium: { tier_budget: 1536, slope: 0.8, min_budget: 1024, max_budget: 4096 }
adjust_interval_s: 30
hysteresis_ms: 100
prefetch_on_kernel_hint: true
kernel_fallback_window_ms: 2000
```
Lena T.: I'll add observability: per-route kernel_switch metric + token_budget history + kv_prefetch_success_rate.
Maya R.: Awesome. Raj, can you land the canary config and ping #eng-oncall when deployed? We'll loop back in 4h with numbers.
Sam K.: will monitor logs and drop a short report. :thumbsup:
Raj P.: landing now. ETA 7m.
